verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a first-party MCP server that brings Statsig into Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, and says users can "Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT." That gives a natural-language route to operate the product, but it runs through external AI clients, and the evidence does not say which operations can be done this way. missing for 10: evidence of which actions (creating or editing gates, experiments, analytics queries) can be performed via natural language, any native in-console natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
